label: The De ente first source of esse is an actual CONCRETE_6 root of the selected grounding at w
paraphrase: Some n is an actual concrete root of the selected grounding relation at w (NecessaryRootFork.ActualRoot: concrete, existing at w, with no actual concrete ground at w), is in act as to being, has its represented esse equal to its essence, has no actual cause of its esse, and heads a finite chain of actual causes of being (Relation.TransGen of ActualEsseCause; mode of causing unspecified, tenseless) to every other being in act. That is, the De ente first source (c35b1a5c) is an actual root at w. Not asserted: that it is the only actual root, exists necessarily, is an efficient cause, conserves anything, or is God.
